# TurboDevs

> Software engineering studio: software for operations that can't stop. We find the process that costs a team hours or opportunities, replace it with software, and keep it running 24/7. Every public claim traces to a named source.

## How we work

1. Diagnose — map the process with the people who do the work and decide what to automate first.
2. Build — automations, integrations and AI agents on the client's own files and systems; numbers come from code, and every figure a model writes is checked before it goes out.
3. Deploy — connect to the portals, files and data sources the team already uses, and work alongside the people who run them.
4. Run — operate what we build: monitoring, daily reports and a check on every output.

## Client work

- Quorelia (energy) — the software behind a solar battery station that operates day and night.
- Sainz Intec (industrial procurement) — an automated responder that answers private bids on its own.
- Confidential energy client — daily performance reporting for a grid-scale battery storage system: a deterministic KPI engine with a written narrative, every number checked against the computed facts before publication, backed by 648 automated tests.
- Grantfox (Web3 marketplace on Stellar) — outside contributors: deployment-safety checks, wallet-scoped authorization, and the purchase-and-delivery interface.
- Vertigo Restaurant (hospitality) — website shipped fast, with ongoing support.

## Products

- SII automation — a company's workflows with Chile's tax authority, automated through a CLI and API, read-only by default. Built on the open-source sii project.
- Previred automation — pension-contribution workflows on Previred, automated and read-only, with payments impossible by design.
- Bid responder — answers private bids and procurement requests automatically. In production at Sainz Intec.
- Energy reporting — daily KPI reports for solar and battery assets, every number checked before the report goes out.

## Open source

- [sii](https://github.com/dostertags/sii) — Automation for Chile's tax authority (Servicio de Impuestos Internos), with 1,178 hermetic tests.
- [previred](https://github.com/dostertags/previred) — Read-only automation of Chile's pension-contributions portal.
- [stellarfit](https://github.com/dostertags/stellarfit) — Subscription checkout settled on Stellar.
- [glowcheck](https://github.com/dostertags/glowcheck) — Computer-vision skin analysis.
- [turbotrabajo](https://github.com/dostertags/turbotrabajo) — Production job-application platform, live at [turbotrabajo.vercel.app](https://turbotrabajo.vercel.app).
